An ultratech installation, capable of creating a stable warp field around itself that destabilizes hyperspace just enough to create ripples in hyperspace - therefore allowing a transverse jump.

Unfortunately, the technology was never mastered, and was quickly marked as "too dangerous" following a pair of unfortunate accidents involving total spacetime collapse and a few dozen hapless orphans.

An old star fortress, seemingly still in operating condition - if low on power. Its dull yellow hull is dulled and pitted by what sensors assume is at least tens of cycles worth of drifting - about the same approximate age of the nearby jump anchor. Your sensors panel emits a shrill spatial-anomaly alarm as it runs over it, detecting numerous space-time anomalies both within and without the hull, many of which seem to be... moving. Tactical advises caution on approach.
